interest: Index on a highly rated 1942 wartime Japan economic report.
overview: Letter (1942): State rates Officer Williams's economic notes on wartime Japan 'EXCELLENT' for their intelligence value.

people.name: Frank S. Williams
people.role: American Foreign Service Officer, Now in the Department of State

subfiles.about: State Department letter from Dean Acheson acknowledging Frank S. Williams's report on Japanese economic and financial conditions and awarding it an 'EXCELLENT' rating.
subfiles.from: Dean Acheson (For the Secretary of State)
subfiles.summary: Acheson tells Officer Williams his wartime economic notes on Japan earned an 'EXCELLENT' rating for their value.
subfiles.title: Letter from Dean Acheson to Frank S. Williams commending report on economic and financial notes
